title: Markets News, April 17, 2026: Indexes Close Higher for 3rd Straight Week; Oil Dives After Iran's Foreign Minister Says Strait of Hormuz 'Completely Open'
body: Major stock indexes ended sharply higher for a third straight week and oil prices plummeted after Iran's foreign minister said that the important Strait of Hormuz shipping channel was "declared completely open" for the duration of the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire.

title: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu gives tips to software engineers on how to survive AI job threat
body: AI won't replace you if you become an expert at your job. That's the message from Zoho CEO Sridhar Vembu, who says software engineers should focus on deep domain expertise rather than just coding speed to stay relevant in the AI era.

title: Internet to AI in Wichita Falls | Opinion
body: Developers responded with details that rarely make headlines. Modern data centers use closed-loop cooling systems that require a one-time water charge of roughly 500,000 gallons. That is about the equivalent of 10 average Wichita Falls homes using 4,000 gallons per month. Ongoing water use is minimal.

title: Technologist warns new AI superintelligence could have sinister consequences for humans

title: Activists arrested, pepper-sprayed trying to remove beagles from Wis. breeding facility
body: Activists were arrested and pepper-sprayed as they attempted to free beagles from a Wisconsin facility licensed to breed them for biomedical testing.
